heroic_strike.name: Heroic Strike
heroic_strike.desc: A strong attack that deals weapon damage plus a bonus.

battle_shout.name: Battle Shout
battle_shout.desc: Bellow a war cry, increasing your attack power for 2 min.

rend.name: Rend
rend.desc: Wound the target, causing bleed damage over 15 sec.

charge.name: Charge
charge.desc: Charge an enemy, stunning it for 1 sec and generating 15 rage. Cannot be used in combat.

thunder_clap.name: Thunder Clap
thunder_clap.desc: Slam the ground, damaging nearby enemies and slowing them for 10 sec.

hamstring.name: Hamstring
hamstring.desc: Maim the enemy, dealing 45% weapon damage and slowing its movement by 50% for 15 sec.

bloodrage.name: Bloodrage
bloodrage.desc: Sacrifice 8% of your health to generate 20 rage.

sunder_armor.name: Sunder Armor
sunder_armor.desc: Sunder the target's armor, reducing it by 8% per stack. Stacks up to 5 times.

execute.name: Execute
execute.desc: Attempt to finish off a wounded foe (below 20% health). Consumes all remaining rage for extra damage.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.desc: Whirl your weapon, striking all nearby enemies for weapon damage.

mortal_strike.name: Mortal Strike
mortal_strike.desc: A vicious strike dealing 110% weapon damage plus a bonus.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.desc: Hurl a ball of fire, dealing damage and leaving the target burning.

frost_armor.name: Frost Armor
frost_armor.desc: Sheathe yourself in frost, increasing armor by 30% for 30 min.

frostbolt.name: Frostbolt
frostbolt.desc: Launch a bolt of frost, damaging the target and slowing it by 40% for 5 sec.

conjure_water.name: Conjure Water
conjure_water.desc: Conjure 5 units of refreshing water, restoring mana when drunk.

fire_blast.name: Fire Blast
fire_blast.desc: Blast the enemy with instant fire damage.

conjure_food.name: Conjure Food
conjure_food.desc: Conjure 5 loaves of bread, restoring health when eaten.

arcane_missiles.name: Arcane Missiles
arcane_missiles.desc: Channel waves of arcane energy at the target for 3 sec.

frost_nova.name: Frost Nova
frost_nova.desc: Blast nearby enemies with frost, freezing them in place for 6 sec.

arcane_explosion.name: Arcane Explosion
arcane_explosion.desc: Detonate arcane energy, damaging all nearby enemies.

polymorph.name: Polymorph
polymorph.desc: Transform a beast or humanoid into a sheep for 20 sec. Any damage breaks the effect. Only one target can be polymorphed at a time.

blink.name: Blink
blink.desc: Teleport 15 meters forward, breaking roots and stuns.

evocation.name: Evocation
evocation.desc: Channel to restore 60% of your mana over 8 sec.

pyroblast.name: Pyroblast
pyroblast.desc: An enormous ball of fire. Long cast, devastating impact.

ice_barrier.name: Ice Barrier
ice_barrier.desc: Shield yourself with ice, absorbing damage for 1 min.

raptor_strike.name: Raptor Strike
raptor_strike.desc: A strong melee attack with your held weapon.

serpent_sting.name: Serpent Sting
serpent_sting.desc: Sting the target, dealing nature damage over 15 sec.

arcane_shot.name: Arcane Shot
arcane_shot.desc: An instant shot of arcane energy.

hunters_mark.name: Hunter's Mark
hunters_mark.desc: Mark the target, increasing all damage it takes by 5% for 2 min.

concussive_shot.name: Concussive Shot
concussive_shot.desc: Daze the target, slowing its movement by 50% for 4 sec.

call_pet.name: Call Pet
call_pet.desc: Call your loyal wolf to fight at your side.

aspect_of_the_hawk.name: Aspect of the Hawk
aspect_of_the_hawk.desc: Take on the aspect of the hawk, increasing ranged attack power for 30 min.

mend_pet.name: Mend Pet
mend_pet.desc: Channel to heal your pet over 5 sec.

multi_shot.name: Multi-Shot
multi_shot.desc: Fire at your target and up to 2 additional nearby enemies for 75% weapon damage.

aspect_of_the_cheetah.name: Aspect of the Cheetah
aspect_of_the_cheetah.desc: Move 30% faster. Taking any hit dazes you and cancels the aspect.

rapid_fire.name: Rapid Fire
rapid_fire.desc: Increases attack speed by 40% for 15 sec.

bestial_wrath.name: Bestial Wrath
bestial_wrath.desc: Send your pet into a rage, increasing its damage by 50% for 18 sec.

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.desc: Racial: restore 20% of your health over 10 sec.
